payload.note: Uniform-twist response checkpoint: for A_theta obtained by multiplying forward/backward axial weights by exp(+/-theta), I_mu=A_theta'(0)=sum_x J_(x,mu) and D_mu=A_theta''(0). Reflection and partition-function differentiation give lambda^2 f_L''(0)=E[D_mu]/N-Var(I_mu)/(N lambda^2)=alpha_L-chi_L, with the axis-average E[D_mu]/N exactly equal to the expected-Hessian coefficient alpha_L. Full-Gibbs binary64 runs find chi_6=0.00021984 and chi_8=0.00021257, leaving positive scaled responses 0.09691 and 0.09532; this is observed, not a thermodynamic theorem. A one-sector response cannot imply full Witten coercivity, so the next gate is the inhomogeneous twist/current-response kernel and an explicit Schur transfer. H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
